purpose: Sample art for the handbook's image components, generated with Codex's built-in image_gen. It follows the mix of an image platform's explore page, such as Midjourney's: eclectic, witty, every image a different type, from illustration in many styles to film stills, animation frames, craft, photography and design. Styles are the reference; no image on such a page is copied. All subjects are invented; no real brand, title, person, existing franchise or living artist's name appears.
style: Quality bar: skilled, confident professional work with a clear subject and a controlled palette. Avoid oversaturation, HDR glow, rainbow colour, ornate fantasy, gold filigree and generic AI gloss. No logos, no watermark, no signature and no real brand. No text unless the prompt asks for it.
